mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces the cost of capital for corporations, supporting higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 5.5%, it signals a weakening labor market and reduced consumer spending, which depresses corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities as corporate revenue growth prospects deteriorate, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative correlation between the joint decline of HOUST and RSAFS and S&P 500 20-day returns is not statistically significant (p>0.05) in a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong labor market growth (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly), corporate hiring and wage growth support consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity and economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The correlation between INDPRO and S&P 500 60-day returns is negative or insignificant (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1500.0 thousand units, it signals a contraction in the housing sector and reduced consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is below 1500.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and an increase in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a severe economic downturn, which triggers a sharp sell-off in equities, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative return effect is not observed when both HOUST declines and UNRATE rises, with a Rank IC < 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation, low-rate regime (CPIAUCSL > 260 and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%), the market anticipates aggressive monetary tightening, which increases equity discount rates and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 260 and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.
